source_pr.title: Add Tags method to Bucket interface for cloud provider metadata retrieval

blast_radius_note: thanos-io/objstore is vendored by all three repos. Concrete Bucket implementors in mimir: pkg/storage/bucket/{prefixed_bucket_client.go, delayed_bucket_client.go, sse_bucket_client.go, client_mock.go}, pkg/storage/tsdb/block/global_markers_bucket_client.go. Concrete Bucket implementors in loki: pkg/storage/bucket/{prefixed_bucket_client.go, sse_bucket_client.go, xcap_bucket.go}. Thanos itself has no concrete Bucket implementations in its non-vendor code — it uses objstore.Bucket as a parameter type only (consumers, not implementors).
